'''Disruptor security beams''' were weapons that shot out thin, [[red]] beams of energy that were capable of slicing beings apart. Ilegal on most [[Planet/Legends|planets]], disruptor beams were used by the criminal [[organization]] that controlled [[Phindar/Legends|Phindar]] in [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], [[the Syndicate]]. These beams were installed in the storerooms of the Syndicate's headquarters.
